item.tib: lha mo srid rgyal dpon g.yog gi skong bshags
item.coloph: de ltar skong bshags bdud rtsi'i rgyan/ nor bu gling gi khrims ldan sogs/ dge sgrab yod do cog rnams kyi/ dge bsam mtha' ru phyin pa'i phyir/ sgo ston kro ta wer zhi yis/ sgo gsum rnam dag ngang nas bkod/ me stag lo zla'i tshes la dge/ me ltar bstan pa 'bar gyur cig/
